Monetary policy decision August 2026

Published 20 August 2026

The decision in brief

The policy rate is left unchanged at 1.75 per cent.

The measured rate of inflation is still low, but there is a risk that underlying inflation will become too high in the wake of the supply shocks.

Sentiment in the economy has improved significantly, but unemployment is still high.

Policy rate

1.75%

Applies from 26 August 2026

Next monetary policy decision
